description: Services the service manager never disables or changes, with the reason shown to the user. Names are exact service names; patterns use PowerShell -like wildcards.

protected.reason: Core Windows service: sign-in, COM, plug and play, the task scheduler, app deployment or servicing depend on it.
Security, update or system management service: firewall, Defender, Windows Update, certificates, the event log and WMI.
Audio or networking basics that games and voice chat need.
Graphics driver service: display settings, overlays or driver features stop working without it.
Anti-cheat service: games refuse to start when it is changed.
